stem:
The kidneys have a role in excretion and in osmoregulation.

Excretion is the removal of the waste products of metabolism or the removal of substances that are in excess.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Name the **main** metabolic waste product excreted by the kidneys.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State **how** this metabolic product is made.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: State **where** this metabolic product is made.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Glomerular filtrate is formed by the process of ultrafiltration.

Describe the process of ultrafiltration.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Different mammals have different thicknesses of medulla relative to the size of the kidney.

Fig. 6.1 shows the relationship between the mean thickness of the medulla in kidneys of different mammals and concentration of urine produced by the kidneys.

{{figure:figure_6_1.webp}}

Suggest an explanation for the relationship shown in Fig. 6.1.
